messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "to make swallowing easier, may open capsule"
set: ["to make swallowing easier, may open capsule", "if trouble swallowing, may open capsule", "can open the capsule if you have difficulty swallowing them", "do not crush, chew, break, or open capsule", "trouble swallowing", "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole open it", "open capsule if child taking capsules for oral suspension", "capsules may be opened if difficulty swallowing", "if you cannot swallow an extended-release capsule whole, open it", "capsule", "call your doctor if you have trouble swallowing a capsule or tablet", "drug interactions may make medicines less effective", "oral capsule", "extended-release capsule", "immediate-release capsule", "pamoate capsule"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
